title: Scratch projects: make, list, open and delete throwaway project folders from eagle view's new-terminal list
summary: Eagle view's new-terminal list can now create throwaway scratch project folders, list them in a pill, reopen or delete them, and asks Delete or Keep when the last terminal or the tab closes; merged on the local gate because Actions is off.
friction: CLAUDE.md's 'Pending until PRD v1' table still says no PRD exists, but docs/PRDs/PRD.md is on main; the stale row will mislead the next preflight
lessons_learned: Adding a terminal in the same render as a brand-new project tab crashes the terminal grid (Maximum update depth exceeded); defer the add one frame, as the scratch code does

deferred.what: Choosing a scratch folder that already holds real data (the home folder, C:\git) makes every subfolder a scratch project: the pill lists .ssh, .claude or real repositories with a bin, closing a real project's tab offers Delete, and one Yes removes it for good (remove_dir_all, no recycle bin); the backend guard trusts the folder the front end sends.
deferred.why: The decision on the scratch-projects ticket says every direct subfolder counts; a guard (warn on a non-empty folder, or a marker file, with the backend reading the setting itself) needs the maintainer's call
